description: This file defines a custom exception class named TransactionException within the OrangeHRM ORM exception namespace. It extends PHP's built-in Exception class and is used to represent transaction-related errors in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: TransactionException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling transaction errors within the OrangeHRM ORM system.
